answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier scans every output as if passing light through a prism to detect hidden duplicates. Each agent must anchor its proof at a specific vertex within the network to claim an identity slot. If an agent attempts to wander between multiple slots, the verifier identifies the non-unique work and triggers immediate exclusion.
